scenario: P4 vacuum-field project upgraded from dev5 to dev12, then corrected after review of overclaimed low-field candidates and development package status.
harness: Claude Code 2.1.281 / DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash produced the first upgrade; the reviewed repair was made by the maintainer after Claude resumption was rejected with unrecognized_model.

review_findings.initial_claim: The Claude first pass called below-10%-of-background interpolated points confirmed nulls or X-points and called a development wheel released.
review_findings.repair: Reclassified the points as low-field candidates, reported unresolved proximity, removed the unsupported no-magnetic-axis check, masked the filament neighborhood in the heatmap, and corrected release wording.

reviewed_result.single_setting_rerun: --only preview writes only preview to the current summary; unselected NPZ files and the old comparison image remained byte-identical.
reviewed_result.independent_archive_rerun: Extracted the reviewed v2 archive into a separate directory, installed its dev12 wheel in a new venv with system site packages, and reran python -I run_field_map.py: 8/8 checks per setting; CSV and all three NPZ files were byte-identical to the reviewed workspace.

limitations: The first-pass 9/9 checks did not catch the unsupported physical interpretation; the reviewed check set is 8/8 and is not the same set.
The reviewed result is maintainer-assisted and cannot count as an autonomous harness correction.
The fresh venv used system site packages and does not demonstrate offline reinstallation of every dependency.
Low-field candidates are not exact roots, magnetic axes, or X-points; many lie in the unresolved filament neighborhood.
Vacuum-only synthetic/development evaluation; equilibrium, plasma response, heating and device validation remain outside this result.
